findings.summary: __attrs_post_init__ pushes id_of(self.schema) unconditionally, so subschemas without $id push an empty/None scope that resets the resolver base and breaks relative $ref resolution; should push only when id is non-empty and not None.

judge.reason: Same defect: unconditional push of id_of(schema) pushes empty/None scope, breaking ref resolution; fix is conditional push.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Scopes pushed in __attrs_post_init__ are never popped (the only pop_scope at line 458 pairs with a different push), so a shared RefResolver accumulates stale scopes, growing memory and leaking scope into sibling subschema resolutions.

judge.reason: Claims scopes are never popped; this is a different complaint and not the None-scope bug.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: Three blank lines before the next top-level def trigger flake8 E303.
findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: The new test only covers a top-level $id with $ref, so it would not catch the relative $ref bug in subschemas without $id.

judge.reason: Test coverage gap claim; tests failing to cover the bug counts as valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
